verdict.rationale: Vendor docs describe a short bring-up path: install Cua Driver once, add it to your agent, then ask it to act (cua-docs-3). They also cite `cua runtime doctor`/`setup` to install missing pieces (cua-docs-10), one-command local taskset runs (cua-docs-12), and no account needed to start (cua-docs-30). A concrete hands-on report contradicts this: across three attempts the user never got a clean first completed task (cua-comm-1). The first run typed in the wrong place, and the next two failed to connect to the Computer API Server WebSocket after 60s, though this was on an older cua-agent version (0.1.29). Missing for 10: an actual step-by-step quickstart document in evidence, independent confirmation that current versions reach a first completed task from docs alone.
